# ghost/daily-diary

Daily Diary (F-Droid): write and read today's diary page, which starts blank every day. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/daily-diary
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/daily-diary open_diary --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/daily-diary write_entry --device <serial> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/daily-diary append_entry --device <serial> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/daily-diary read_entry --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/daily-diary list_previous --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_diary`: Open my Daily Diary page
- `write_entry`: Write in my diary: a calm day
- `append_entry`: Add to my diary: and cooked dinner
- `read_entry`: What did I write in my diary today?
- `list_previous`: Show my previous diary entries
